request.report: Round 5 (round 4 of 12 on spec-replay). Checked the state after the previous run: off-greedy, A-greedy, B-greedy, and off-prod all have complete results (4 phases each, requests.jsonl, vram.txt, server logs; draft_n/draft_n_accepted present on all A/B fg rows). A's single-agent 86.0 is an artifact of spec-induced greedy loops hitting max_tokens (mem0-r0/0/2, mem0-r2/0/2), while off finished those normally; without length rows, A is 54.3 tok/s, off is 56.2. Therefore, no spec setting beats off on dual. Added sections 9c/9d to bench/m1-notes.md (off-prod table: dual-agent fg 31.2, no length 32.6; decision: no infra change, provisionally). MMproj result: no rejection on text-only traffic; 0 'restore checkpoint' lines (SRV_TRC-level logging, expected). Next run: A/prod, per the plan's best-of-A/B rule (25.5 > 23.0).
